title: TripAdvisor restaurant reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one diner or visitor review, charged), location (context for a restaurant or attraction, free) and status (per location and language, free).

dataset.title: TripAdvisor restaurant reviews
dataset.description: One row per diner review, plus per-location context and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; location and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error, wrong-type and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
